text: Forza Horizon 6 is introduced as the sixth entry in the acclaimed racing subseries and the fourteenth main instalment in the overarching Forza franchise, set within a vast, fictionalised representation of Japan. In truth, its meticulously crafted open world map stands as the franchise's largest and most vertically complex to date, centered around a stylised version of Tokyo that boasts expressways and tight Shibuya-style crossings five times larger than the urban environments of its predecessor. Drawn partly by immense fan demand for a Japanese setting, the game allows players to begin their journey as a tourist exploring the countryside, before eventually rising through the ranks to qualify for the prestigious Horizon Festival. The player's progression is tracked by a returning wristband system—a feature unseen since the earliest titles—which culminates in reaching a gold wristband to unlock exclusive events on Legend Island. On their journey to becoming a racing legend, players can acquire and customize over 550 real-world vehicles, utilizing them in new gameplay modes like narrow, mountain-pass Touge Battles and underground Daikoku-style car meets. Players can also purchase awe-inspiring homes and fully customizable garages, such as a mountainside Estate in rural Japan, to display their prized car collections. As the game progresses, it showcases cutting-edge visual technology powered by Turn 10 Studios' in-house ForzaTech engine, introducing a new ray-traced global illumination system, dynamic weather that reflects seasonal changes across cherry blossom fields and snow-covered slopes, and refraction-based shaders for car headlights. Developed exclusively for ninth-generation hardware by Playground Games and published by Xbox Game Studios, the game officially launched worldwide for Windows and Xbox Series X/S on May 19, 2026, following a four-day early access period for Premium Edition owners. It went on to feature key art showcasing a GR GT Prototype and a Toyota Land Cruiser 250 with Mount Fuji in the background, and its release marks a highly anticipated milestone that will eventually bring the franchise to the PlayStation 5 later in 2026.
